item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

turns.text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.

dialog.agent:
Your photos already tell a lovely café story—from the storefront to the coffee, pastries, barista, and cozy interior.

**I can’t render this exact reel with the connected tools:** the available video assembler only supports hard cuts, not the smooth photo transitions you requested. I haven’t generated anything or spent credits.

For the result you want, use these settings in Instagram’s editor or CapCut:

- **Format:** vertical 9:16, 10 seconds total.
- **Order:** storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior.
- **Timing:** roughly 2 seconds per photo; confirm the total stays at 10 seconds after transitions.
- **Transitions:** short, 0.3-second cross-dissolves.
- **Framing:** use a blurred background behind the wider photos so nothing important gets cropped.
- **Music:** relaxed instrumental piano or acoustic guitar, with no vocals.
- **Text:** none.

This will preserve your actual photos and give them the gentle, cohesive feel you’re after.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried starting the reel with a free-plan-compatible model at 480p, but Magic Hour refused the first clip because **the account has insufficient credits**. No video was generated and no credits were spent.

You don’t necessarily need a paid plan—enough credits for the generation would let us try again. The fallback would still use all five photos in order, with gentle motion, relaxed instrumental music, no text, and simple cuts.

opening.text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.
